INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
(
    master_run_id,
    master_pipeline_nm,
    trigger_type_cd,
    run_type_override_cd,
    run_param,
    child_total_cnt,
    child_succ_cnt,
    child_fail_cnt,
    status,
    created_by
)
VALUES
(
    '@{pipeline().RunId}',
    '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',
    'MANUAL',
    'REQUEST',
    '{"request_src":"ETL_SIGNAL"}'::jsonb,
    0, 0, 0,
    'RUNNING',
    'ADF'
)
ON CONFLICT (master_run_id) DO NOTHING;

WITH signal_src AS
(
    SELECT
        s.signal_id,
        s.src_db_nm,
        s.src_schema_nm,
        s.src_table_nm,
        s.load_type,
        s.load_col,
        s.load_unit,
        s.lookback_n,
        s.load_from,
        s.load_to,
        s.incr_load_method,

        m.target_cnt,
        m.target_id,
        m.src_type,
        m.master_schema_nm,
        m.master_table_nm,
        m.init_wait_yn

    FROM adfadm.etl_signal s

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL
    (
        SELECT
            COUNT(*) AS target_cnt,
            MIN(t.target_id) AS target_id,
            MIN(t.src_type) AS src_type,
            MIN(t.src_schema_nm) AS master_schema_nm,
            MIN(t.src_table_nm) AS master_table_nm,
            MIN(t.init_wait_yn) AS init_wait_yn

        FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master t

        WHERE UPPER(t.src_db_nm) = UPPER(s.src_db_nm)
          AND UPPER(t.src_schema_nm) = UPPER(s.src_schema_nm)
          AND UPPER(t.src_table_nm) = UPPER(s.src_table_nm)
          AND t.data_class = 'RAW'
          AND t.delete_yn = 'N'
    ) m ON TRUE

    WHERE s.status = 'NEW'
      AND NOT EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run p
          WHERE p.signal_id = s.signal_id
      )
    ORDER BY s.signal_id
    LIMIT 100
    FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
),

validated AS
(
    SELECT
        s.*,

        CASE
            WHEN target_cnt = 0
                THEN 'TARGET_NOT_REGISTERED'

            WHEN target_cnt > 1
                THEN 'MULTIPLE_TARGETS_FOUND'

            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND init_wait_yn = 'Y'
                THEN 'INITIAL_LOAD_REQUIRED'

            WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(src_type, ''))
                 NOT IN ('DB2', 'MSSQL')
                THEN 'UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_TYPE'

            WHEN load_type NOT IN ('FULL', 'INCR')
                THEN 'INVALID_LOAD_TYPE'

            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND (
                    COALESCE(TRIM(load_col), '') = ''
                 OR COALESCE(load_unit, '')
                    NOT IN ('DAY', 'WEEK', 'MONTH')
                 OR COALESCE(lookback_n, 0) < 1
                 OR load_from IS NULL
                 OR (
                     load_to IS NOT NULL
                     AND load_to <= load_from
                 )
             )
                THEN 'INVALID_INCR_RANGE'

            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND load_unit = 'MONTH'
             AND load_to IS NOT NULL
             AND TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMM')
                 >= TO_CHAR(load_to, 'YYYYMM')
                THEN 'INVALID_MONTH_RANGE'

            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND COALESCE(incr_load_method, '')
                 NOT IN
                 (
                     'UPSERT',
                     'INSERT_ONLY',
                     'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                 )
                THEN 'INVALID_LOAD_METHOD'

            -- RANGE 삭제 구간의 DAY/WEEK는
            -- 일 단위 경계만 허용
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND incr_load_method = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
             AND load_unit IN ('DAY', 'WEEK')
             AND (
                 load_from::time <> TIME '00:00:00'
                 OR (
                     load_to IS NOT NULL
                     AND load_to::time <> TIME '00:00:00'
                 )
             )
                THEN 'INVALID_RANGE_TIME_BOUNDARY'

            WHEN COALESCE(src_db_nm, '')
                 !~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$'
              OR COALESCE(master_schema_nm, '')
                 !~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$'
              OR COALESCE(master_table_nm, '')
                 !~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$'
              OR (
                   load_type = 'INCR'
                   AND COALESCE(load_col, '')
                       !~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$'
                 )
                THEN 'INVALID_IDENTIFIER'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS error_code

    FROM signal_src s
),

resolved AS
(
    SELECT
        v.*,
        UPPER(src_type) AS dbms_type,

        CASE WHEN UPPER(src_type) = 'MSSQL'
             THEN '[' || master_schema_nm || ']'
             ELSE UPPER(master_schema_nm)
        END AS sql_schema_nm,

        CASE WHEN UPPER(src_type) = 'MSSQL'
             THEN '[' || master_table_nm || ']'
             ELSE UPPER(master_table_nm)
        END AS sql_table_nm,

        CASE WHEN load_type <> 'INCR' THEN NULL
             WHEN UPPER(src_type) = 'MSSQL'
             THEN '[' || load_col || ']'
             ELSE UPPER(load_col)
        END AS sql_column_nm,

        CASE WHEN load_type = 'FULL'
             THEN 'full' ELSE 'incr'
        END AS path_type,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'FULL' THEN 'daily'
            WHEN load_unit = 'DAY' THEN 'daily'
            WHEN load_unit = 'WEEK' THEN 'weekly'
            WHEN load_unit = 'MONTH' THEN 'monthly'
        END AS frequency_nm,

        TIMEZONE(
            'Asia/Seoul',
            statement_timestamp()
        ) AS batch_dt

    FROM validated v
),

range_sql AS
(
    SELECT
        r.*,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'FULL' THEN NULL

            WHEN load_unit = 'MONTH'
            THEN format(
                '%s >= %L',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMM')
            )

            WHEN dbms_type = 'DB2'
            THEN format(
                '%s >= TIMESTAMP(%L)',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD-HH24.MI.SS')
            )

            WHEN dbms_type = 'MSSQL'
            THEN format(
                '%s >= CONVERT(datetime2, %L, 126)',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
            )
        END AS from_condition,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'FULL'
              OR load_to IS NULL THEN NULL

            WHEN load_unit = 'MONTH'
            THEN format(
                '%s < %L',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(load_to, 'YYYYMM')
            )

            WHEN dbms_type = 'DB2'
            THEN format(
                '%s < TIMESTAMP(%L)',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(load_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD-HH24.MI.SS')
            )

            WHEN dbms_type = 'MSSQL'
            THEN format(
                '%s < CONVERT(datetime2, %L, 126)',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(load_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
            )
        END AS to_condition

    FROM resolved r
),

prepared AS
(
    SELECT
        r.*,

        LOWER(
            'pl_raw_ingest_' || dbms_type
            || '_' || src_db_nm
        ) AS child_pipeline_nm,

        CASE
            WHEN error_code IS NOT NULL THEN NULL

            WHEN dbms_type = 'DB2'
             AND load_type = 'FULL'
            THEN format(
                'SELECT * FROM %s.%s WITH UR',
                sql_schema_nm, sql_table_nm
            )

            WHEN dbms_type = 'MSSQL'
             AND load_type = 'FULL'
            THEN format(
                'SELECT * FROM %s.%s WITH (NOLOCK)',
                sql_schema_nm, sql_table_nm
            )

            WHEN dbms_type = 'DB2'
             AND load_type = 'INCR'
            THEN format(
                'SELECT * FROM %s.%s WHERE %s WITH UR',
                sql_schema_nm,
                sql_table_nm,
                CONCAT_WS(' AND ', from_condition, to_condition)
            )

            WHEN dbms_type = 'MSSQL'
             AND load_type = 'INCR'
            THEN format(
                'SELECT * FROM %s.%s WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE %s',
                sql_schema_nm,
                sql_table_nm,
                CONCAT_WS(' AND ', from_condition, to_condition)
            )
        END AS final_extract_query,

        CASE
            WHEN error_code IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE format(
                '%s/frequency=%s/batch_datetime=%s/',
                path_type,
                frequency_nm,
                TO_CHAR(batch_dt, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI')
            )
        END AS final_landing_path,

        CASE
            WHEN error_code IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE format(
                '%s.%s.%s.default.%s%s.parquet',
                UPPER(src_db_nm),
                UPPER(master_schema_nm),
                UPPER(master_table_nm),
                TO_CHAR(batch_dt, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),
                LPAD(signal_id::text, 10, '0')
            )
        END AS final_file_name

    FROM range_sql r
),

range_meta AS
(
    SELECT
        p.*,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'FULL'
            THEN 'FULL_DELETE_INSERT'
            ELSE incr_load_method
        END AS final_load_method_cd,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND incr_load_method = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
            THEN UPPER(load_col)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS final_range_column_nm,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND incr_load_method = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
            THEN CASE
                WHEN load_to IS NULL THEN '>='
                ELSE 'BETWEEN'
            END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS final_range_operator_cd,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND incr_load_method = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
             AND load_unit = 'MONTH'
            THEN CASE
                WHEN load_to IS NULL
                THEN jsonb_build_array(
                    TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMM')
                )
                ELSE jsonb_build_array(
                    TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMM'),
                    TO_CHAR(
                        date_trunc('month', load_to)
                        - INTERVAL '1 month',
                        'YYYYMM'
                    )
                )
            END

            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND incr_load_method = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
             AND load_unit IN ('DAY', 'WEEK')
            THEN CASE
                WHEN load_to IS NULL
                THEN jsonb_build_array(
                    TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMMDD')
                )
                ELSE jsonb_build_array(
                    TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMMDD'),
                    TO_CHAR(
                        load_to - INTERVAL '1 day',
                        'YYYYMMDD'
                    )
                )
            END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS final_range_value

    FROM prepared p
),

ready AS
(
    SELECT
        r.*,

        CASE
            WHEN error_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN error_code

            WHEN final_extract_query IS NULL
                THEN 'EXTRACT_QUERY_NOT_GENERATED'

            WHEN final_landing_path IS NULL
              OR final_file_name IS NULL
                THEN 'GEN2_PATH_NOT_GENERATED'

            WHEN LENGTH(child_pipeline_nm) > 200
                THEN 'PIPELINE_NAME_TOO_LONG'

            WHEN LENGTH(final_file_name) > 200
                THEN 'FILE_NAME_TOO_LONG'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS final_error_code

    FROM range_meta r
),

-- ============================================================
-- 이번 실행에서 신규 등록된 Child만 확보
-- ============================================================
claimed AS
(
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    (
        signal_id,
        master_run_id,
        target_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        run_type_cd,
        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,
        range_column_nm,
        range_operator_cd,
        range_value,
        incr_policy_id,
        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        incr_to_val,
        src_type,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,
        data_class,
        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,
        init_wait_yn,
        status,
        created_by
    )
    SELECT
        r.signal_id,
        '@{pipeline().RunId}',
        r.target_id,
        r.child_pipeline_nm,
        r.load_type,
        'GEN2',
        r.final_load_method_cd,
        r.final_range_column_nm,
        r.final_range_operator_cd,
        r.final_range_value,
        NULL,
        CASE WHEN r.load_type = 'INCR'
             THEN r.load_col END,
        CASE WHEN r.load_type = 'INCR'
             THEN r.load_from::text END,
        CASE WHEN r.load_type = 'INCR'
             THEN r.load_to::text END,
        r.src_type,
        r.src_db_nm,
        r.master_schema_nm,
        r.master_table_nm,
        'RAW',
        r.final_extract_query,
        r.final_landing_path,
        r.final_file_name,
        r.init_wait_yn,
        'PENDING',
        'ADF'

    FROM ready r
    WHERE r.final_error_code IS NULL

    ON CONFLICT (signal_id)
    WHERE signal_id IS NOT NULL
    DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        landing_path,
        file_name,
        extract_query,
        ingest_pipeline_id,
        master_run_id,
        signal_id
),

rejected AS
(
    UPDATE adfadm.etl_signal s
    SET
        status = 'FAILED',
        error_msg = LEFT(r.final_error_code, 2000)
    FROM ready r
    WHERE s.signal_id = r.signal_id
      AND s.status = 'NEW'
      AND r.final_error_code IS NOT NULL
    RETURNING s.signal_id
),

counts AS
(
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM claimed)
            AS claimed_cnt,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM rejected)
            AS rejected_cnt
),

master_updated AS
(
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
    SET
        child_total_cnt = c.claimed_cnt,
        child_succ_cnt = 0,
        child_fail_cnt = 0,

        run_param =
            COALESCE(m.run_param, '{}'::jsonb)
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'claimed_cnt', c.claimed_cnt,
                'rejected_cnt', c.rejected_cnt
            ),

        status = CASE
            WHEN c.claimed_cnt = 0
             AND c.rejected_cnt = 0 THEN 'SKIPPED'
            WHEN c.claimed_cnt = 0 THEN 'FAILED'
            ELSE 'RUNNING'
        END,

        skip_reason_cd = CASE
            WHEN c.claimed_cnt = 0
             AND c.rejected_cnt = 0 THEN 'ETC'
            ELSE NULL
        END,

        end_dt = CASE
            WHEN c.claimed_cnt = 0 THEN NOW()
            ELSE NULL
        END,

        error_log = CASE
            WHEN c.rejected_cnt > 0
            THEN 'SIGNAL_VALIDATION_FAILED: '
                 || c.rejected_cnt::text
            ELSE NULL
        END,

        updated_by = 'ADF',
        updated_dt = NOW()

    FROM counts c
    WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'

    RETURNING m.master_run_id
)

-- ============================================================
-- ADF ForEach 반환
-- 신규 INSERT에 성공한 Child만 반환
-- ============================================================
SELECT
    c.ingest_pipeline_nm,
    c.landing_path,
    c.file_name,
    c.extract_query,
    c.ingest_pipeline_id,
    c.master_run_id
FROM claimed c
CROSS JOIN master_updated m
ORDER BY c.signal_id;
